subject: Trial choreography & owner handoff for ScaleRetail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lewis <jamie.lewis@scaleretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed trial choreography

Thanks again for the time earlier, Jamie — great conversation. Quick recap and a concrete trial choreography so your team can review with procurement/security.

Call highlights:
- Primary business goal: reduce per-search latency on product recommendations and cut embedding inference cost by ~30% while maintaining relevance.
- Success metrics you called out: P95 generation latency < 300ms, embedding cost < $0.0006 per unit, topical precision (top-5) >= 78%.
- Data scope: ~10k anonymized product descriptions + 150k recent click events for evaluation.

Proposed 4-week trial choreography (high level):
1) Week 0 (prep): sign NDA/SOW, share data sample + access matrix, infra connectivity baseline.
2) Week 1 (ingest & smoke): upload sample, run smoke tests, baseline metrics.
3) Week 2 (tuning & evaluation): iterate model config, caching & batching settings, run eval prompt set.
4) Week 3 (acceptance & handoff): acceptance run, runbook transfer, procurement close (if green).

RACI (high level) — please confirm or correct:
- Infra (network, VPC peering, credentials): Responsible = Karthik Iyer (Redwood), Accountable = ScaleRetail infra lead, Consulted = Monica, Informed = Marissa
- App (integration & sample workload): Responsible = ScaleRetail app lead, Accountable = Monica Patel (Redwood) for validation tests
- Security & compliance (data handling, SOC2 evidence): Responsible = Karthik (Redwood) for evidence, Accountable = ScaleRetail security
- Procurement & contract: Responsible = Jamie / Anita (ScaleRetail), Accountable = Marissa (Redwood)

Immediate asks:
- Jamie: confirm procurement contact (cc'd Anita if OK) and whether a signed SOW by Aug 25 is feasible.
- Please confirm the data sample ETA (preferably by Aug 22) and any internal blackout dates between Aug 26–Sep 3.

Attached: short success criteria workbook (ScaleRetail_POI_SuccessCriteria.xlsx) and a one-page trial infra checklist. I drafted a light SOW (SOW_draft_v1.docx) for procurement to review; will push a DocuSign link once agreed.

If you agree with the plan above, I'll lock in tentative trial start week of Aug 26 (flexible to Sept 2 if you prefer).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Lewis <jamie.lewis@scaleretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@scaleretail.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial choreography

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A couple of notes/questions: 

- Procurement: looping in Anita (copied). Anita, are you the right person for SOW/PO? We're hoping to keep the SOW minimal but will need terms for data handling and a limited liability clause.
- Security: we will need SOC2 Type II report and a data retention policy before we start ingestion. Can Karthik share the latest artifacts?
- Dates: I’m traveling the last week of Aug. Can we target a kickoff of week of Sept 2 instead? That would give us time to align legal/procurement.
- Data: we can pull the 10k product descriptions by Aug 25; click events require an internal scrub — target Sep 1.

If you can send the SOC2 and a brief PRFAQ on how Redwood handles KV cache and ephemeral logs, we’ll review with security. Otherwise, happy to proceed.

—Jamie
Head of Engineering, ScaleRetail
jamie.lewis@scaleretail.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lewis <jamie.lewis@scaleretail.com>
Cc: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@scaleretail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial choreography

Thanks, Jamie — Sept 2 kickoff is fine; updated timeline below. Anita, appreciate you joining — happy to align on minimal SOW terms.

Updated trial timeline:
- Prep (by Aug 29): NDA + SOW signed, Drive folder shared, small data sample received.
- Kickoff (Sept 2): infra connectivity validated, baseline smoke run.
- Tuning (Sept 8–12): model/config iterations, caching profile tests.
- Acceptance window (Sept 15–19): acceptance run and metrics review.

Core artifacts I’m attaching now: SOW_draft_v1.docx (light commercial terms + trial scope) and trial-infra-checklist.pdf (what we ask your infra team to provision). Also link to SOC2 artifacts and a short PRFAQ on caching/ephemeral logs in the related links.

Detailed RACI (please confirm who at ScaleRetail will be each role):
- Redwood Infra Owner (R): Karthik Iyer — will provision peering, credentials, run initial smoke tests
- Redwood App Validation (R): Monica Patel — will own integration tests and acceptance evaluation scripts
- ScaleRetail Infra (A): [ScaleInfraLead] — action items: open firewall rules, accept peering, schedule connection window
- ScaleRetail App (A): [ScaleAppLead] — provide sample API endpoints & test harness
- Security (C): ScaleRetail security team — will validate SOC2 & data handling
- Procurement (I): Anita / procurement team — will finalize PO/SOW

Open items for your team:
- Confirm names for ScaleInfraLead and ScaleAppLead (we can template emails once you confirm)
- Agree on a production-equivalent redaction workflow for click events (if click events are needed in-trial)

Next steps (my action items):
- Share DocuSign SOW link by EOD Aug 21 for Anita to review.
- Karthik will attach SOC2 packet and a one-pager on KV cache retention.
- Monica to prepare acceptance test checklist and share by Aug 28.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Lewis <jamie.lewis@scaleretail.com>, Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@scaleretail.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Trial infra handoff notes (ScaleRetail)

Internal checklist / quick runbook for infra handoff — copying external for visibility.

1) Credentials & Access
- Create service account for ScaleRetail (scaleretail_trial@redwood-svc) with time-limited key.
- Karthik to initiate VPC peering request; include permitted CIDR ranges and expected ports (443, 22 for debug).

2) Data onboarding
- Dropbox/GDrive share: request product descriptions (10k csv) and sample click events (anonymized csv).
- Data validation script: run schema check (columns: id,title,desc,category) and run basic PII scan.

3) Smoke & acceptance tests
- Smoke script: 1000 sample calls for generation + 5k embed calls to capture latency distribution.
- Acceptance script: evaluate P95 latency and top-5 precision against the provided gold set. Monica will run and publish report to Drive.

4) Security artifacts
- Karthik to upload SOC2 pack and short cache retention PRFAQ to shared Drive link by EOD Aug 21.

5) Oncall / escalation
- Week-of trial: primary oncall = Redwood infra (Karthik), secondary = Redwood app (Monica).

I’ll draft the acceptance checklist and drop it into the Drive folder once Marissa confirms final timeline.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: trial-infra-checklist.pdf, SOW_draft_v1.docx
